reportedBehavior: Store page offered an update while Companion 2.1.5 showed its ordinary Store Updates action

freshQuery.buttonDescription: A Companion update is available. Open Microsoft Store to check and install updates when convenient. The Companion never installs an update itself.

method: Existing read-only diagnostic host loads the exact published EXE under installed Store identity; isolated settings/cache, monitoring and user actions disabled. Not normal app activation.
interpretation: The real app daily cache suppresses a fresh request until due. With a fresh isolated cache the released production query returns Available and updates the button. No detection/interop failure reproduced.
recommendation: Consider a shorter quiet check interval, such as six hours, and exposing last/next check time. Requires a future source/package and documentation change; daily cadence also remains in 2.1.6.
serviceLimits: One check per 30 minutes and ten per 24 hours; service publication delay and cached responses are separate from our own daily throttle.
